title: austrobassia stelligera
intro: Austrobassia stelligera, commonly known as the 'star anise tree', is a plant species native to Australia and Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from digestive issues, nausea, and other gastrointestinal problems due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Austrobassia stelligera involve its use in traditional medicine to alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and as an anti-inflammatory agent. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include shikimic acid and other terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
